expectedRealization.rationale: Weather-driven generation scarcity could affect power volumes/pricing within weeks, but durability and company economics were unresolved.

changeHypothesis.summary: Sichuan/Chongqing drought and heat caused real industrial curtailments and thermal balancing demand, but power stocks had already rerated dramatically before cutoff while H1 thermal economics remained weak or loss-making.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The physical shock was real but weather-driven and likely short-lived.
disconfirmingEvidence: 华能 H1 lost RMB3.0bn due high coal costs.
Power basket already outperformed CSI300 by ~30pp over 20d and ~40pp over 60d.

causalChain.mechanism: Lower hydro output plus record cooling demand increases thermal generation need.
Extra utilization only helps if tariff/fuel spread is positive.
causalChain.failureMode: high coal costs absorb volume benefit

directWinners: thermal generators with positive fuel/tariff spread
falseThemeMatches: power names rallying on scarcity despite weak generation economics

selectionComparison.rationale: Physical scarcity is real, but no candidate combines durable positive earnings conversion with unabsorbed price expectations.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Power equities had already surged: 华电 +71pp versus CSI300 over 60d, 华能 +22pp, 国电 +27pp, while H1 thermal economics remained weak.
expectations.measurableGap: No credible remaining expectation gap after the rerating and weak fuel spread.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: No selection: short-duration weather shock, weak H1 thermal economics and extreme prior rerating.

bearCase: Weather normalizes before extra generation creates material profit, while already-rerated power stocks mean-revert.
nextResearchActions: No selection. Require durable realized spread improvement before revisiting.
